repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
t1 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
delay(20 MIN)
t2 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
diff = t2 - t1
if (diff >= 3) {
    (#Study_AC).airConditioner_setAirConditionerMode("cool")
}

diagnosis.summary: The candidate introduced an absolute-value correction (lines 4-7) to handle negative differences, but the IR only triggers on a rise of at least 3 ($t2 - t1 >= 3$). In the provided trace, the temperature was constant (3), so $t2 - t1 = 0$, which fails the IR condition. The candidate's logic incorrectly evaluated the condition after the absolute-value step, causing a false positive action. The fix removes the unnecessary absolute-value block and relies solely on the IR's signed difference.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value correction block that altered the semantics of the difference check. The revised script strictly follows the IR's condition ($t2 - t1 >= 3$) without modifying the sign of the difference.
